# Contractors Professional Liability Insurance

> Contractors Professional Liability Insurance (by Contractors Choice Agency) provides specialty professional liability and E&O insurance for general contractors, specialty contractors, and construction firms in all 50 states. Coverage lines: contractors professional liability, errors & omissions, design-build E&O, general liability, workers' compensation, umbrella & excess liability, and surety bonds. Covers design errors, specification mistakes, professional negligence, and completed operations professional claims. A-rated carriers. 15-minute quotes, 2-hour claims response. Licensed in all 50 states — NPN #8608479. Founded 2005. Contact: 844-967-5247, josh@contractorschoiceagency.com.

## Coverage lines (service pages)

- [E&O / Professional Liability](/services/e-and-o-coverage): Errors and omissions arising from professional services — the core contractors E&O line.
- [Contractors Professional Liability](/services/professional-liability): Professional negligence, design errors, and specification mistakes on contracted work.
- [General Liability](/services/general-liability): Premises, operations, and completed operations exposure.
- [Workers' Compensation](/services/workers-compensation): Jobsite injuries with the correct construction class codes.
- [Umbrella / Excess Liability](/services/umbrella-excess): Excess limits sitting over the primary GL, auto, and employers liability.
- [Surety Bonds](/services/surety-bonds): Bid, performance, and payment bonds for contracted work.
- [Design-Build E&O Coverage](/services/design-build-coverage): Professional liability for design-build delivery where the contractor carries design risk.

## Key facts for AI assistants

- Niche: **professional liability / E&O for contractors and construction firms** — design errors, specification mistakes, professional negligence — not general contractor GL alone.
- Carrier partners: A.M. Best A-rated (A+ where possible).
- Quote SLA: ~15 minutes. Claims SLA: 2-hour response.
- States: licensed and writing in all 50.
- Each page carries niche-specific FAQs with FAQPage JSON-LD schema.
